segments.text: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan,

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?
And he said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.

footnotes.text: + shew…: Heb. uncover mine ear

segments.text: And David sware moreover, and said,

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.
Then said Jonathan unto David,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.

footnotes.text: + Whatsoever…: or, Say what is thy mind and I will do, etc
+ desireth: Heb. speaketh, or, thinketh

segments.text: And David said unto Jonathan,

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth-lehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.

footnotes.text: + sacrifice: or, feast

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the LORD with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?
And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee:

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?
Then said David to Jonathan,

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?
¶ And Jonathan said unto David,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: Come, and let us go out into the field.
And they went out both of them into the field.
And Jonathan said unto David,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: O LORD God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day, and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;

footnotes.text: + sounded: Heb. searched
+ shew…: Heb. uncover thine ear

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: The LORD do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the LORD be with thee, as he hath been with my father.

footnotes.text: + shew…: Heb. uncover thine ear

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the LORD, that I die not:

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the LORD hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.
So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: Let the LORD even require it at the hand of David’s enemies.

footnotes.text: + made: Heb. cut

segments.text: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

footnotes.text: + because…: or, by his love toward him

segments.text: Then Jonathan said to David,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.

footnotes.text: + empty: Heb. missed

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.

footnotes.text: + quickly: or, diligently: Heb. greatly
+ when the…: Heb. in the day of the business
+ Ezel: or, that sheweth the way

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the LORD liveth.

footnotes.text: + no hurt: Heb. not any thing

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the LORD hath sent thee away.

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD be between thee and me for ever.
¶ So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.

heading: David Absent from the King's Table

segments.text: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, and David’s place was empty.
Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought,

segments.speaker: Saul
segments.text: Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.
And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David’s place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son,

segments.speaker: Saul
segments.text: Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?
And Jonathan answered Saul,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth-lehem:

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king’s table.
Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him,

segments.speaker: Saul
segments.text: Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother’s nakedness?

footnotes.text: + Thou…: or, Thou perverse rebel: Heb. Son of perverse rebellion

segments.speaker: Saul
segments.text: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.

footnotes.text: + shall…: Heb. is the son of death

segments.text: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
¶ And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
And he said unto his lad,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot.
And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

footnotes.text: + beyond…: Heb. to pass over him

segments.text: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: Is not the arrow beyond thee?
And Jonathan cried after the lad,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: Make speed, haste, stay not.
And Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: Go, carry them to the city.

footnotes.text: + artillery: Heb. instruments
+ his lad: Heb. the lad that was his

segments.text: ¶ And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.
And Jonathan said to David,

segments.speaker: Jonathan
segments.text: Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever.
And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.

footnotes.text: + forasmuch…: or, the LORD be witness of that which etc
